interface.signature: def search(S: str, pat: str) -> List[int]

preconditions.description: The length of the text string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the pattern string pat is between 1 and the length of S.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(S) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned indices are within the bounds of the text string S.

postconditions.expression: all(S[index-1:index+len(pat)-1] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each index in the return value corresponds to a starting position of the pattern pat in the text string S.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) - len(pat) + 1) if S[i:i+len(pat)] == pat)
postconditions.description: The number of occurrences of the pattern pat in the text string S matches the length of the return value.
